Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Suzie Bates and Sophie Devine are the openers for New Zealand Women. Shamilia Connell to start with the ball. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! 260 is what New Zealand Women have to chase. The target is still a stiff one and need their batters to step up now. Can they do it and begin their campaign with a win? Stay tuned to see how the chase unfolds.

Hayley Matthews is up for a quick chat. Matthews says that it is a good score and this is one of her best knocks. Adds that Courtney Walsh told her yesterday that she would be opening the batting. Mentions that 260 is a par score and it is a good wicket to bat on.

The bowlers of New Zealand Women leaked plenty of runs upfront but Lea Tahuhu got a huge early strike early on and then Jess Kerr struck as well to calm things down. They toiled to get the third wicket but Tahuhu struck in her comeback spell to find success. What didn't help them was all the misfields that resulted in boundaries which allowed the opponents to settle. However, the bowlers kept chipping in with timely wickets and kept the run flow in check and as a result, have managed to restrict their opponents to a par total. Lea Tahuhu picked up three wickets but was a bit expensive while the Kerr sisters were very economical with the ball and shared 3 wickets amongst them.

West Indies Women had a frantic start as they were only dealing in boundaries but lost two crucial wickets of Deandra Dottin and Kycia Knight as well. Hayley Matthews though continued to play her strokes and steadied the ship for her side building two crucial partnerships with Stafanie Taylor and Shemaine Campbelle. Matthews went on and scored a brilliant century and first of this World Cup despite having a bit of an injury. It looked like they will score over 275 when she was at the crease but after her departure, others failed to change gears and would feel that they are certainly 15 to 20 runs short.

West Indies Women built some crucial partnerships in the middle but failed to put a foot on the accelerator at the death. They have still done well to score above 250. New Zealand Women will be the happier team here and would feel the target is within their reach and would be confident of chasing it down and start their campagin with a victory.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is a length ball, on middle. Anisa Mohammed flat-bats it towards long on and looks for the second run. Amelia Kerr runs in from long on, collects the ball and throws it to the keeper. Katey Martin grabs the ball and whips the bails off. Anisa Mohammed is well short of her crease. West Indies Women end with 259/9.

FOUR! Two in a row! Good length ball wide of off stump. Mohammed swings the bat hard again and the ball takes a thick edge and runs down to third-man for a boundary. Crucial runs for West Indies Women.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary! Short ball, on middle and leg. Anisa Mohammed steps out and pulls it to wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Excellent shot that!

Katey Martin takes a simple catch and this is a good passage of play for New Zealand Women.

New Zealand Women have taken a review for an LBW. Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that the impact is umpire's call and it is missing the wickets. The original decision stands. New Zealand Women retain their review.

Hayley Matthews walks back to the pavilion with a huge round of applause.

She pushes hard for the second run and gets it comfortably. The third umpire is called for a run out check but she's home. She raises her bat and soaks all the applause. This has been a fantastic knock from her and she will look to stay till the end.

Review! Sophie Devine has opted for a review as Shemaine Campbelle has been struck on her pad. Was there an inside edge? The UltraEdge says no. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it indicates three reds. Shemaine Campbelle has to walk back now.

OUT! LBW! The pressure was building on and Amelia Kerr bowls an excellent googly, on middle. Shemaine Campbelle presses forward and looks to defend but fails to read the googly and gets thudded on the front pad. New Zealand Women appeals but the umpire says no. They opt for a review. UltraEdge shows a flat line and the Ball Tracker shows that the ball was pitching outside off, the impact was in line and it's clipping the leg stump. Excellent review from the White Ferns. The original decision is reversed. New Zealand Women retain their review as well but more importantly, have got a wicket here and Amelia Kerr has broken this partnership.

Brooke Halliday looks to be in some pain. Looks like she has hurt her fingers. The physio rush in to check up on her. Meanwhile, the players take drinks to rehydrate themselves. Brooke Halliday is fine now and we are set to resume.

Drinks! West Indies Women lost two early wickets but Stafanie Taylor and Hayley Matthews have steadied the ship since then. They would want to continue the good work while New Zealand Women would look to break this partnership as soon as possible to put them back on the back foot.

A full toss, on off. Stafanie Taylor misses out on this one. She pushes it straight to mid on.
Short of a length, on off. Hayley Matthews pulls it to deep square leg and crosses ends.
Another short ball, on off. Hayley Matthews ducks underneath.
On the pads, Taylor clips it to square leg for a single.
Bangs a short ball, on off. Stafanie Taylor looks to cut but gets beaten.
Slower through the air, outside off. Left alone.
Flatter and outside off, Taylor punches it to sweeper cover for one.
A half-tracker this time, on leg. Stafanie Taylor rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg. The fielder runs to her left and parries it to the covering fielder. Two taken!
Tossed up nicely, on middle. Stafanie Taylor presses forward and blocks.
Loopy ball again, outside off. Stafanie Taylor drives it nicely through covers. The fielder from deep point runs across and cuts it off. Keeps it down to two.
Loopy ball, on middle. Matthews punches it to long on for a run.
WIDE! Kerr starts with a flighted ball, going beyond the tramline on the off side. Hayley Matthews lets it be. Wided.
Amelia Kerr comes to bowl.
Full again, outside off. Stafanie Taylor drives it towards covers.
WIDE! Length ball, down the leg side. Stafanie Taylor misses her flick. Wide called.
Fuller, outside off. Stafanie Taylor drives it to cover.
Short of a length, outside off. Stafanie Taylor cuts it hard but finds backward point.
Nicely driven but no run! Full and on off, Stafanie Taylor drives it crisply but straight to mid off.
On a good length, on off. Stafanie Taylor shows full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Full and on middle, Hayley Matthews clips it to mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Hayley Matthews stands tall and punches it through covers. She retains the strike with a single.
Full and around off, Hayley Matthews keeps it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Hayley Matthews punches it behind point for a couple of runs.
Full and on off, driven to mid on.
Short ball, on middle. Stafanie Taylor mistimes her pull and gloves it to the left of Katey Martin for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Stafanie Taylor looks to cut but misses.
End of the Powerplay 1! 4 fielders can be now stationed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Good-length delivery, around off. Matthews gets behind the line of the ball to block it.
A low full toss, on middle. Matthews tucks it to mid-wicket.
Leg bye! A full ball, around leg. Stafanie Taylor misses her flick and gets hit on her pad. The ball rolls behind square on the leg side for a leg bye.
Devine serves a length ball, around leg. Taylor tickles it through fine leg and comes back for the second run.
Another ball, full and outside off. Stafanie Taylor drives it to the fielder at extra cover.
Devine starts with a full ball, outside off. Stafanie Taylor drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, outside off. Hayley Matthews drives but straight to the cover fielder.
Good-length ball, around off. Hayley Matthews lunges forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, on middle. Stafanie Taylor dabs it towards covers for a quick single.
On a length, outside off. Stafanie Taylor blocks it off the front foot.
Wide! Rowe spills it way down leg. Stafanie Taylor lets it be and the umpire signals a wide.
A length ball, outside off. Stafanie Taylor gets forward to defend but it takes the outside edge and rolls towards the slip fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Stafanie Taylor keeps it out.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews digs it out towards cover.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, outside off. Hayley Jensen looks to defend off the front foot but she misses.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Back of a length, on middle and leg. Matthews stays back and whips it through square leg to fetch herself a boundary.
Hammered but for no run! Fuller and outside off. Hayley Matthews square drives it but straight to the point fielder.
Full and outside off. Hayley Matthews drives hard but finds the cover fielder.
On a length, around leg. Stafanie Taylor nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Rowe drags her length back a bit, around off. Hayley Matthews blocks it.
Another ball, on a length and jagging back in from middle. Hayley Matthews gets forward and blocks it towards mid on.
Back of a length, outside off. Hayley Matthews looks to cut hard but she misses.
A length ball, darted on the pads. Taylor nudges it around the corner and takes a single to get off the mark.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Stafanie Taylor leaves it alone.
A length ball, around off. Stafanie Taylor taps it to the off side.
Matthews misses out this time! Short and wide, outside off. Matthews looks to cut hard but she gets it from the inner half of her blade towards cover.
Pitches it up, around off. Hayley Matthews gets forward and keeps it out.
Back of a length, just outside off. Hayley Matthews stays back to slap it towards the cover fielder.
On a length, around off. Hayley Matthews blocks it out.
FOUR! Top shot! Matthews is playing some glorious shots here! Short of a length, outside off. Hayley Matthews hangs back and punches it past the fielder at cover to bag a boundary.
The skipper, Stafanie Taylor walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! West Indies Women lose their second wicket and it is Kycia Knight who walks back to the hut now! Knight looks to join the party but she holes out in doing so! This is a length ball, outside off. Knight prods and looks to go over mid off but she miscues it in the air only towards the mid off fielder where Fran Jonas takes a sitter.
Commentary.Howout: c Fran Jonas b Jess Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Full and angling across, Kycia Knight guides it to third man for a single.
Full and outside off. Kycia Knight leans and drives it towards covers. The fielder dives to her left and puts a stop.
A single off the bat! Length ball, around off. Hayley Matthews looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge to backward point for a single.
FOUR! Beauty! Full ball, on middle. Hayley Matthews stands tall and plays a glorious straight drive. There is no chance of stopping that. A boundary!
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Length ball, outside off, nipping away. Hayley Matthews presses forward and defends it towards covers.
Hannah Rowe comes into the attack now.
A dot to finish the over! Good-length ball, on middle, nipping away. Kycia Knight blocks it out. Good comeback by Jess Kerr after gettting hit for a boundary off the first ball.
Full again, on off. Kycia Knight lunges forward and keeps it out.
Full and outside off, Kycia Knight drives it towards covers.
On a length, on off. Kycia Knight defends it out.
Fuller and around off, Kycia Knight defends it towards covers.
FOUR! Glorious! Kycia Knight opens her account with a boundary as well. Full ball, on off. Kycia Knight drives it straight down the ground to long off for a beautiful boundary.

FOUR! Hayley Matthews is only dealing in boundaries at the moment! This is a gorgeous shot! Good-length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews rocks back and simply drives it through covers. The outfield is fast and the ball races away to the ropes in a flash.
Good-length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews lets this one go.
FOUR! Short and punished! Hayley Matthews is looking in great touch! Short ball, on middle. Hayley Matthews gets on top of that and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
WIDE! On a length, down the leg side. Hayley Matthews misses her flick. Wided.
FOUR! Nicely played! Width offered outside off. Hayley Matthews gets back and punches it through the cover region to pick up another boundary.
Length ball, outside off, nipping away. Hayley Matthews looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Kycia Knight walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Lea Tahuhu had a poor first over but she strikes now and removes the dangerous Deandra Dottin! Lea Tahuhu pitches it full, on the pads. Deandra Dottin tries to work it across the line. She looks to flick but miscues it. The ball goes off the leading edge towards mid off where Jess Kerr takes a simple catch. First blow to West Indies Women as Deandra Dottin has to walk back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Jess Kerr b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: A dot to end! Full and outside off, Hayley Matthews drives it but straight towards covers. So, just the boundary off the over!
Keeping it full, outside off. Hayley Matthews pushes it towards covers.
Full again, on off, jagging back in. Hayley Matthews drives it to mid off.
Full and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Wow! Hayley Matthews gets off the mark in style as well. Full-length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews creams her cover drive through cover-point. No need to run for those! A boundary!
An inswinging full toss, on off, just below the waist height. Hayley Matthews works it to mid on.
Who will bowl from the other end? Jess Kerr it is.

FOUR! Third boundary of the over! This is a dream start for West Indies Women! Another length ball, outside off. Deandra Dottin hops and cuts it through covers. The ball races away to the fence in a flash.
Good-length ball, on off. Deandra Dottin taps it towards point.
Touch fuller this time, nipping away, on off. Deandra Dottin plays it towards covers.
FOUR! Nicely played! Lea Tahuhu misses her length and bowls a full toss, on middle. Deandra Dottin takes full toll of it and works it nicely past mid-wicket for another boundary.
Good comeback from Tahuhu! Fuller, on middle. Deandra Dottin pushes it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! What a start for West Indies Women and Deandra Dottin! Lea Tahuhu bowls a length ball, outside off, offering width. Deandra Dottin gets enough room and she cuts it through covers for a boundary.

We are done with the national anthems and it is time for game number 1 to begin! The match officials and the players have made their way out to the middle. Deandra Dottin and Hayley Matthews to open the batting for West Indies Women. Lea Tahuhu will start proceedings with the ball.
The players have lined up for their respective national anthems. First, it will be the anthem of West Indies, followed by the anthem of New Zealand.

PITCH REPORT - Nasser Hussain and WV Raman are near the pitch. The latter says that it looks like a very good pitch to bat on. Adds that there is some nice covering grass but the batters are going to enjoy their time in the middle and it promises to be a high-scoring game.

Amelia Kerr is up for a quick chat. She says that the preparations have been good and she can't wait to be out there. Tells that she has worked hard on her batting and how she wants to tackle the spin. Mentions that teams are going to come hard on them and it is just about taking the challenge. Tells that they are prepared and are ready to face any challenge.

Stafanie Taylor, the skipper of West Indies Women, says that they wanted to bat first. Adds that they had good games against Pakistan and South Africa and also had good preparation in the warm-up matches. Tells that they are really looking forward to this game.

Sophie Devine, the skipper of New Zealand Women, says that they will bowl first. Tells that it is a good build-up for the World Cup. Mentions that there is not going to be any pressure. Says that it is a new wicket and they are not sure how it will behave so they want to put West Indies in and see how it goes.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews, Kycia Knight (WK), Stafanie Taylor (C), Shemaine Campbelle, Chedean Nation, Chinelle Henry, Aaliyah Alleyne, Anisa Mohammed, Shakera Selman, Shamilia Connell.
New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Sophie Devine (C), Suzie Bates, Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite, Maddy Green, Brooke Halliday, Katey Martin (WK), Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr, Hannah Rowe, Fran Jonas.
TOSS - New Zealand Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

New Zealand Women have been in top form recently and the hosts will certainly as favourites. They are a good blend of youth and experience and the White Ferns would be high on confidence coming into this clash. West Indies Women too, are a side consisting of some star players but they have their task cut out as they face a tough opposition in New Zealand Women in the tournament opener. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the opening game of the Women's World Cup, 2022 where New Zealand Women will take on West Indies Women. This promises to be a cracking contest between two quality sides who will be eager to start off on a winning note.
